hero.headline: SIGNATURE JOURNEYS, TO ISCHIA AND BEYOND.
hero.subheadline: Itineraries planned down to the last detail, so you can enjoy Italy at an easy pace.

video_section.title: Italy, at an easy pace
video_section.body: With Baywatch Travel you discover the places you already love and the ones you didn't know you wanted to see. From the wonders of the coast to the villages inland, every trip is built around you, with no rush and no standard packages.

trasferimenti.title: Private Transfers
trasferimenti.body: Every trip begins and ends with the same care. Our private transfers to and from the airports guarantee complete comfort, flawless punctuality and a calm atmosphere from the very first moment. We take care of every detail so you can focus simply on the pleasure of arriving.

soggiorni.title: Tailor-Made Stays
soggiorni.body: Whether it's a romantic getaway of a few days or a longer stay to get to know the island in depth, we select the most authentic and refined accommodation for you. Every proposal is looked after down to the smallest detail, for an experience that stays with you.

escursioni.title: Excursions into the Heart of the Landscape
escursioni.body: Expert local guides take you to discover hidden trails, breathtaking views and secret corners that only the people who live here can reveal. Every excursion is a genuine story: safe, memorable, and yours to keep forever.

termali.title: Thermal Waters
termali.body: Ischia's thermal springs are among the most celebrated in Europe. We guide you to the island's best thermal parks and wellness facilities for a deeply relaxing experience.

services_about.title: About us
services_about.body:
Baywatch Travel was born in Casamicciola Terme, on the island of Ischia. We handle every side of incoming travel: transfers from airports and ports, hotels, guided excursions, food and wine experiences and thermal spa itineraries.

We work with a network of local partners chosen one by one over the years. No chains, no hidden intermediaries.

Whether it's a weekend on Capri or a tour through Rome and Tuscany, we build the itinerary starting from what you tell us, not from a catalogue.
services_about.image_alt: View of the Ischia seafront, near our office in Casamicciola Terme

review.quote: Everything taken care of down to the last detail. The boat trips, the dinners overlooking the sea, even the small hiccups were handled without us noticing. We'll be back.
review.author: Giulia and Marco R., Milan

plan_trip.title: Plan your trip
plan_trip.body: Tell us where you'd like to go and what you'd like to experience. You don't need to have it all worked out: a hunch is enough, or a photo you saw somewhere. We'll take care of the rest.

faq.q1: Do you only organise trips to Ischia?

faq.a3: Yes, our team can be reached 24/7 for anything you need.

destinations.meta_description: Our destinations in Italy: Ischia, Capri, the Amalfi Coast, Rome, Tuscany and much more.
destinations.hero_subtitle: Iconic places and breathtaking views of the Mediterranean.

descriptions.ischia: Thermal springs steaming on the beach, lush gardens, the Aragonese Castle rising from the water.
descriptions.capri: The Faraglioni, the Blue Grotto, Villa Lysis. Elegance that never goes out of style.
descriptions.procida: Pastel houses, fishing boats, unhurried days.
descriptions.napoli: Pizza, narrow alleys, Vesuvius in the background. A city that doesn't ask your permission.
descriptions.sicilia: Greek temples, Baroque towns, smoking Etna. A journey within a journey.
descriptions.sardegna: Crystal-clear water, hidden coves, a stubborn interior.
descriptions.puglia: Trulli, masserie, white towns and a sea that changes colour every hundred metres.
descriptions.calabria: Tropea, Scilla, sheer cliffs and a sea that looks like the Caribbean.
descriptions.roma: Two thousand years of history around every corner. The Eternal City can still surprise you.
descriptions.toscana: Rolling hills, cypresses, medieval villages, wines that taste of the land.

services_page.meta_description: Group and private transfers, stays with multilingual assistance, excursions, food and wine tours, hiking and thermal spas. The services of Baywatch Travel.

hero.title: Our services
hero.subtitle: Transfers, stays, tours and excursions, tailor-made trips.
hero.image_alt: The coast of Ischia, where Baywatch Travel is based

intro: We are a tour operator with long-standing experience in tourism, specialising in organising stays, tours and experiences for individual travellers and for groups of every size.

Our approach brings together competitive prices, professionalism and attention to our clients: we offer travel packages that are particularly good value and designed around different needs, without ever compromising on the quality of our services, attention to detail and the satisfaction of those who choose to travel with us.

transfer.title: Transfer services: our flagship
body: We offer individual and group transfers, designed to give you maximum comfort, punctuality and assistance at every stage of the journey.
We organise transfers tailored to your needs, taking care of every detail of the service from your arrival to your final destination.

subsections.title: Airport welcome
body: The service begins right at the airport, where one of our multilingual assistants will meet and welcome you. Our staff provide a professional, attentive welcome, giving you all the information you need and accompanying you through the required procedures.

subsections.title: Transfers to the port of departure
body: We offer a range of transport options, depending on the number of passengers and your specific needs:
Private cars for individual transfers or small groups;
Minivans for medium-sized groups;
Coaches for large groups.
Every transfer is organised with particular attention to punctuality, comfort and timing, ensuring smooth coordination between the airport, the ferry connections and your chosen accommodation.

subsections.title: Handling procedures and providing tickets
body: Where the service includes it, we also take care of the necessary procedures and provide the relevant tickets, to make your experience as simple and well organised as possible.

subsections.title: Assistance throughout the service
body: Our support goes beyond the transfer itself. We provide assistance for the entire duration of the service, giving you a single point of contact for any needs, questions or requests that may come up along the way.
Our aim is to offer a complete, reliable and personalised service, in which you feel looked after and supported at every moment.
Professionalism, organisation and attention to the client are at the heart of every transfer we provide.

bullets: Airports in central and southern Italy, and the ports of Naples, Pozzuoli and Salerno
transfer.image_alt: Man on a ferry looking at a coastal town and castle under a blue sky

soggiorni.title: Stays

subsections.title: Beach holidays
body: If you want to get away from everyday life and enjoy some peace and quiet, we offer relaxing beach holidays, designed to let you enjoy the sea, the sun and your free time completely at ease.

subsections.title: Group stays, tailor-made
body: Managing groups is the core of our professional life. We work with hotels of every category, for everyone from families to agencies. We build packages to order, with multilingual assistance at every stage of the trip.

soggiorni.image_alt: Relaxing view of a Mediterranean resort on Capri, Italy, with sun loungers and parasols by the pool.

escursioni.title: Tours and experiences
body: We organise escorted tours and tailor-made itineraries, working with experienced tour leaders and professional guides who can turn every trip into a genuine, engaging experience.

From cultural visits to excursions, from local traditions to the most striking places, we offer unforgettable experiences, designed to let you get to know and live each destination fully and in an original way.
A wide range of excursions and experiences to suit every taste, to discover the area through ever-changing itineraries, landscapes and atmospheres.
Whether you prefer a panoramic tour, history and culture, the sea and sailing, or getting close to nature, we have the right excursion for you.

subsections.title: Discovering the island
body: The ideal way to start getting to know the island is the classic island tour, available by minibus, coach, boat and/or sailing ship.

An itinerary that lets you take in striking views, see the most characteristic places and discover, comfortably accompanied, the many sides of the island: its villages, coastline, landscapes and traditions.

subsections.title: Boat excursions: the charm of the islands
body: The sea is also the star of our boat excursions to the nearby islands, each with its own identity and charm.
You can sail to Capri and Procida, admiring them from a privileged vantage point and enjoying a day at sea, with its views, crystal-clear water and unforgettable scenery.

subsections.title: Trekking and nature: when the journey moves you
body: And if you are looking for trails, nature and adventure, bring the right shoes!
We will take you along routes where Nature rules, with panoramic paths, the scents of Mediterranean vegetation and glimpses of the sea.
Here land and sea meet, and all the elements of Life seem to merge into a single landscape.

bullets: Pompeii, Vesuvius, the Royal Palace of Caserta
Food and wine tours and winery visits
Hiking on the Epomeo trails and the Path of the Gods
escursioni.image_alt: Group hiking on a trail in Campania

su_misura.title: Tailor-made trips for every need
body: We believe every traveller has different needs, expectations and wishes. That is why we don't simply offer standard packages: we can design and organise tailor-made trips, built around each client's needs.

Whether you are travelling alone, as a family, with a group of friends, an association or a school group, we work out the right trip together, taking care of the organisation and coordinating every aspect of the experience.
From the first contact until you are back home, we have one goal: to turn every trip into an experience to remember.
Expertise, value for money, attention to detail and care for people are the values we put into every proposal, because for us client satisfaction is an integral part of the journey.
bullets: Written proposal with clear items and prices
Changes until the programme is right

tours.title: Tours and excursions in the places we love
tours.intro: The Amalfi Coast, Positano, Pompeii and Sorrento are destinations where we offer day trips and transfers. Not stays, but tailor-made experiences.

amalfi.name: Amalfi and Sorrento Coasts
amalfi.tagline: From Amalfi to Positano along the SS163, by boat or coach, as you prefer.
activities: Boat tour of Amalfi, Furore and Conca dei Marini
Visit to Amalfi Cathedral and Atrani on foot
Scenic coach ride along the SS163 with photo stops
Lunch at an agriturismo overlooking the gulf
amalfi.image_alt: Panoramic view of the Amalfi Coast

positano.name: Positano
positano.tagline: Vertical, photogenic, a natural stage set that still works.
activities: Boat tour with a swimming stop at Li Galli and Praiano
Spiaggia Grande and a visit to the village
Guided hike on the Path of the Gods (Bomerano–Nocelle)
Sunset on a terrace with an aperitivo
positano.image_alt: Positano's houses on the hillside above the beach

pompei.name: Pompeii
pompei.tagline: A Roman city frozen in AD 79. Always with a licensed guide.
activities: Tour of the Pompeii excavations with a licensed guide (~3h)
Herculaneum and MAV, the Virtual Archaeological Museum
Vesuvius extension: walk up to the crater (45 min each way)
Lunch at an agriturismo and Vesuvius wine tasting
pompei.image_alt: Ruins of Pompeii with columns and a statue

sorrento.name: Sorrento
sorrento.tagline: A base for the coast or a stop in its own right. Lemon groves, views of the gulf, a slower pace of life.
activities: Guided tour of the old town and the Cloister of San Francesco
Vallone dei Mulini and Marina Grande
Lemon tour: citrus grove visit and limoncello tasting
Bagni della Regina Giovanna: a natural pool among Roman ruins
sorrento.image_alt: Aerial view of Sorrento and the Villa Comunale

story.title: Our story, our Ischia
story.lead: Tourism has always been our world.
paragraphs: I started my career working across different areas of the tourism industry, from hotel hospitality to tour operating, taking care of planning, organisation and customer support over the years. Different experiences that let me see tourism from every angle and, above all, understand how much people, listening and attention to detail really matter.

In 1999 came the big leap: the decision to turn that experience and passion into a project of my own. That is how Baywatch Travel was born, back then a small business with a tiny office and plenty of drive.

From that moment a journey of growth began, built step by step through daily work, the trust of our clients and the many partnerships that have allowed us to grow together over the years. That small agency became an established company, deeply rooted on the island of Ischia.

Today Baywatch Travel has more than 20 people on the team and is a point of reference in the island’s tourism scene. It is a result we are proud of, but above all we see it as a responsibility: to keep offering professionalism, reliability and care every day.
In an industry that is always changing, we like to hold on to the values that have been with us from the start: knowledge, reliability, availability and care for the client.
Because behind every trip there is not simply a booking, but a person who entrusts us with their time, their expectations and the wish to have a good experience.

And that is exactly what we have been committed to for more than twenty-five years: knowing this land, understanding its value and turning our experience into trips organised with passion and professionalism.
Baywatch Travel has grown, but the spirit is the same as it was then: do the work well, keep our word and build relationships based on trust over time.
closing: This is how we do tourism.
